scientific_integrity: The proof separates all residue cases, uses only the exact factorization criterion for \(p\mid\varphi(m)\), the Chinese remainder theorem, and Dirichlet's theorem. Finite computation is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats odd prime moduli and gives no effective uniform bound for the least witness. Composite-modulus analogues are not claimed.
title: No nontrivial odd-prime Ramanujan-type congruences for Euler's totient
